title: Five Past the Door
subtitle: A KINETIC BLUEPRINT
prompt: Original geometric motion design, not a waveform: a luminous doorway made from five translucent glass panes and thin architectural lines. Cold-open on one bright offset frame, assemble panes in a five-count, rotate the accent grouping halfway through, then collapse into near-black during the silence-led drop before rebuilding with brighter chartreuse edges. End on the initial offset frame so the film can loop. No people, faces, rooms, stock footage, logos, private artifacts, or text-heavy UI.
